## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] API/documentation change
- [ ] Security/privacy hardening
- [ ] Installer/release change
- [ ] Refactor with no intended behavior change

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:visual` (or explained below why not applicable)
- [ ] Relevant Windows installer/portable scenario tested, if packaging changed

Commands, results, and manual scenarios:

```text

```

## Compatibility, data, and security

- [ ] Existing `/api/v1` clients remain compatible, or the breaking change is explicitly approved/versioned.
- [ ] `docs/openapi.yaml`, README, tests, and CHANGELOG were updated for any public API change.
- [ ] On-disk changes include a versioned, failure-safe migration and upgrade test.
- [ ] Privacy/security documents were updated for new data, network, credential, permission, or retention behavior.
- [ ] No real keys, credentials, prompts, files, results, user-data stores, logs, or identifying paths are included.
- [ ] User-facing Chinese and English strings remain synchronized.
